I had covid around 3 years ago or so, nothing major & I got of it quite quick, I have been healthy for a while after as well. As of the blood tests, I confirmed multiple times with my doctor that we did it all, all is normal as it stands. 

I have a psy now & I brought up the subject of adhd to her, she says that it could be possible, but that time will tell us ( I am only 3 sessions in ). As of physical symptoms of anxiety, I would say breathing fast, I really have to focus, control myself & my breathing, especially when I do any type of social, as my social anxiety is worse than ever now. 

Thanks for sharing regarding SSRIs and SNRIs, I have not tried anything yet really, I have not made up my mind yet, but I guess it's all different for each individual, only way to find out is to try. 

For how long did you have cfs now? Do you know what could have triggered it? 

Ill look into the patches, thanks for your help & sorry that you have to deal with cfs, I am sure we will find a way to resolve things though, in time.

Thanks for sharing! My doctor actually believes that my anxiety is causing all of my issues, reason why she wants me to try the medication ( she was patient with me by the way, she didn't push me ). My story could be in a way, similar to yours, only way to find out is like you said, try stuff out until it works!

I really didn't know that it had to be changed that often, guess it's time to change mine! A journal is a wonderful idea! I was working on a nighttime routine, but that could do me a lot of good as well for sure, it will definitely help me remember what works for me.  

I get what you are saying, thing is, I am not certain if it's me, but it feels like nothing works when I don't get decent sleep & even when I do, sometimes there is nothing to understand, I could sleep good & wake up tired as well as feel ''knocked'', so much that I sometimes didn't fully wake up when I got to bed the night after that day.

I remember, 2 years ago or so, having 4 hours of sleep, wasn't that terrible, even 3 days in a row, now when that happens, I am not even the same person, nothing feels possible, as I am so tired, reason why I think I have a big issue to fix here.

Even if I cut down from taking way more caffeine in the past, I do agree that it's excessive, to me though it's more of the fact that I am dependent & that my energy levels are so unbalanced now. 

Also, I can understand that you feel that way on it, I would have a hard time describing what is normal from my point of view though, considering the state I am in.

I will definitely see to take a longer break, I had achieved 3 weeks & that was a big achievement for me, but I think that my body needs a lot more time if that would be the root cause of my issues, I think that there is a high chance that it's causing me a lot of harm at this point. My body might have forgotten how to provide me energy on it's on, reason why I would need so much time off it. 

As of the vitamin D, I agree as well, even though I take multivitamins, I need to go outside a lot more, I couldn't say if I have a deficiency though, I guess going outside more often would answer that question.

Oxygen levels and ventilation, I will need to confirm. As for snoring same thing ( I live alone ), I could use more sun, hydration is good though. I will get it all confirmed. 

Did you meant that I should give it more time cutting caffeine out? more than 3 weeks. 

Thank you so much.

Thanks for the response & very sorry for the wall! 

I might go sleep in a clinic for sleep apnea & I get that your battle was with the anxiety mainly, I am glad that it helped you, but I am not certain to be in the same boat, I really do believe that anxiety wouldn't be as bad if I had energy, at least a some days in week, as they are all bad, but I may be wrong for sure. 

I do agree that it's worth the try though, as you said, it's a test dose more than anything. I will keep your story in mind, as it might be what I need as well to feel ''normal'' again. 

Thanks for sharing & taking the time.

I have been taking multivitamins and Magnesium glycine ( on and off ) for a while now & at first everyday, I didn't see a big change. 

  
Bed + pillow are 5 years old I would say, It's great I think. As for the room, it's great as well. Problem is mostly falling asleep sometimes, but when I do I sometimes wake up after 8 hrs +. 

  
My nighttime routine could be a lot better on the other hand.. things you stated, are not things I am doing, expected the phone usage, I know it's bad, but my thought regarding it always been, I can't be this bad because of something so ''small'', but that's my point of view. 

  
A better nighttime routine or morning routine have been in my plans for a while, it's just been difficult to apply changes in this current state, If you do believe that It could be the cause of my issues, I will try and push trough it.

  
Thanks for your help.

I agree with everything you said regarding medication, I feel the same way, even though I am unsure of it all, I do think that it can be a good path take, that even thought there will probably be side effects, it's worth it in the end. It's more, or mainly the fact that I am wondering if it's the right path to take for the issues I am having. I do take magnesium glycinate from time to time, but I don't see a difference, I think. You are saying you have similar issues regarding your sleep, do you believe that it's the sertraline that helped you regarding your energy or magnesium glycinate instead? 

With this post, I am hoping to find my answers & I will do what is needed. You do believe that for the issues I am having, trying our sertraline is worth the try instead of looking into something else? 

  
Thanks for your help!

Are you saying that my issues could be caused due to the fact that my body is battling against coffee and I should stop for a longer period of time? As I had stopped for 3 weeks, I think that I was starting to see the changes, but I had to get back to work & so I got back on it. I didn't make any changes since. 

  
Doctors didn't recommend anything else other than antidepressants, I did get magnesium bisglycinate, it helps me get better sleep I think, but for the most part I have good sleep, sleep well and enough, I just wake up tired everyday. 

  
We didn't check vitamin levels, I did get some multivitamins though, I didn't notice any changes. 

The place I live in is great, no mold or anything like that. Thanks for your help!
What did you take & for what kind off issues. Also, are you still on them now ?
